protocol.scope: Sensitivity of existing goals/xG mixture only; not a replay of the full events/context live model.
protocol.holdout: all available completed 2026-season matches; used once after development choice
protocol.selection: lowest pooled development multiclass 1X2 Log Loss; ties follow fixed variant order
limitations: Historical provider revisions/availability unverified; imports occurred after matches.
Prior model and mappings were developed after some test matches; holdout is retrospective, not genuinely blind.
No historical injuries, lineups, shot/event details or contemporaneous odds reconstructed.
Any threshold subset is descriptive, not betting profitability or a reason to promote a model.

goals.method: 5000 paired bootstrap replicates, UTC match-date blocks; descriptive 95% interval, no multiplicity adjustment
